info.title: SecretVault Management API
info.description: Versioned management and metadata contract for the SecretVault credentialed egress gateway. The generic proxy is documented separately because upstream response bodies are not typed by SecretVault.

tags.name: Secrets
tags.description: Masked secret metadata and lifecycle operations

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path remainder, treated strictly as upstream path/query data. It must not replace the configured origin.

/proxy/{profile}/{path}.description: Proxy contract: authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <linking_key>; the profile controls credential injection, allowed methods, path prefixes, destination origin, and DNS pinning. Caller query parameters pass through as query data. Caller Host, Authorization, and Connection headers are not trusted; response bodies are opaque upstream data and sensitive response headers are stripped.

x-secretvault-contract.request_headers: Caller headers pass through except Host, Authorization, and Connection; SecretVault injects the profile credential.
x-secretvault-contract.query: Query parameters pass through unchanged as upstream query data.
x-secretvault-contract.redirects: Redirects are not followed by SecretVault.
x-secretvault-contract.response: Status, non-sensitive headers, and opaque upstream body are returned; upstream body sanitization is not claimed.
x-secretvault-contract.errors: SecretVault-generated errors use the ErrorEnvelope schema; upstream responses retain their upstream status/body semantics.

post.description: Regenerate a client application's linking key, atomically invalidating the prior key via key_version. Critical operation requiring a recent, client-bound step-up (X-SecretVault-StepUp). On a concurrent regeneration returns 409 KEY_REGENERATE_CONFLICT.

Reveal a client application's plaintext linking key. Critical operation requiring a recent, client-bound step-up (X-SecretVault-StepUp). A step-up minted for a different client is rejected with 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: SecretVault linking key or session token

header_name.description: Required for auth_method 'header'. Must be a valid HTTP field-name token (RFC 7230) and must not be a reserved hop-by-hop, framing, routing, or credential header.

cookie_name.description: Required for auth_method 'cookie'. Must be a valid cookie-name token (RFC 6265).

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code or 8-12 character one-time recovery code

Proxy.description: Opaque upstream response or a SecretVault ErrorEnvelope.

RequestId.description: Correlation ID for the request and its audit event.
